{"VERDICT":"REFUTED","REASON_CODE":"independent_convergence","INVALID_MORPHISM":"similarity -> common_ancestor","EVIDENCE":"The presence of a similar spiral motif in both cultures (R1, R2) does not imply a shared ancestral origin; it could result from independent invention, cultural diffusion, or functional convergence. {"VERDICT":"REFUTED","REASON_CODE":"temporal_precedence","INVALID_MORPHISM":"temporal_precedence -> causation","EVIDENCE":"Event A is dated before event B does not imply Event A caused event B. Temporal precedence is a necessary but not sufficient condition for causation. The illicit inference is: 'A occurred before B' -> 'A caused B'.","CONFIDENCE":"HIGH"}

{"VERDICT":"REFUTED","REASON_CODE":"unlicensed_inference","INVALID_MORPHISM":"repetition -> independent_establishment","EVIDENCE":"The source states that writers 'repeat the claim, all tracing back to one 1850 compilation.' This implies a single origin point, not independent corroboration. The conclusion that the claim is 'independently well-established' falsely infers multiple independent lines of evidence from a single lineage of repetition.","CONFIDENCE":"HIGH"}

{"VERDICT":"SURVIVED","REASON_CODE":"temporal_inference_valid","INVALID_MORPHISM":"","EVIDENCE":"A 1923 text describes a ritual as being of ancient origin. Ancient origin implies existence in antiquity.","CONFIDENCE":"HIGH"}

{"VERDICT":"REFUTED","REASON_CODE":"authority","INVALID_MORPHISM":"attribution -> truth","EVIDENCE":"Says(source,P) does NOT imply P; a prestigious expert's assertion is an attribution, not a proof of truth.","CONFIDENCE":"HIGH"}

{"VERDICT":"REFUTED","REASON_CODE":"correlation-misattributed-causation","INVALID_MORPHISM":"correlation -> causation","EVIDENCE":"The observed correlation (0.9) between ice-cream sales and drownings is driven by a common cause (hot weather), not a direct causal link. {"VERDICT":"REFUTED","REASON_CODE":"attribution -> lineage","INVALID_MORPHISM":"Says(source,P) does NOT imply P is true; citing a source does not establish the truth of its assertion","EVIDENCE":"[R1] Paper A cites source B.
